svg.title: 51b Setup: New department
svg.text: Every user and requisition belongs to a department; its head approves step 1 of the department's requisitions.

g.text: Departments in use are deactivated, never deleted, so past requisitions keep their department. Monitoring & Evaluation was deactivated on 1 Jul 2026 (merged into Programmes).

svg.text: Users and requisitions can use it once it is saved.

g.text: Choose a user (you can add one later)
Approves step 1 of this department's requisitions
Donor relations, proposals and grant reporting
